{{Quote|He should be able to read the entire Imperial computer network.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 3">[[Star Wars (1977) 3|''Star Wars'' (1977) 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Imperial computer network''' was the vast collection of computerized data stored aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]]. By accessing it, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was able to determine the location of the station's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] controls and the location where [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was being held prisoner.
